caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely a matter of rolling momentum. The terrain here does not believe in switchbacks; old farming trails and ridge routes go straight up the fall line, carved by water and cleared by hand. When the clay gets wet or the gradient hits thirty percent, the most experienced riders know there is no shame in walking. In fact, it is simply part of the rhythm. You dismount, you breathe, and you look out at a valley that few others will ever see. The mountain always dictates the gear.
